result.description:
MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Monash Health exists to reimagine care, so that people can live their best lives. 


We provide safe and equitable care, for every stage of life, delivered with world-leading expertise and over 175 years of experience. 


As a leading academic health service, we're committed to providing tomorrow's care today by integrating research, teaching and training into everyday practice. 


Our team of 24,000 people are full hearted, open minded and all in. Together, we provide more than 250 integrated services for every stage of life at over 50 locations and in the community across south-east Melbourne, Victoria, serving 1.2 million residents in the South Metro Local Health Service Network. 


To see first-hand what our colleagues think about working here, take a look at the following short videos monashhealth.org-careers.








Application Architect




Care, reimagined


Design and deliver innovative learning that builds clinical digital capability


Permanent, full time role, hybrid workplace model




Make a Difference Through Digital Health



About The Design & Architecture Services Team.




The Design & Architecture Services Team provides organisation-wide architecture governance and solution design leadership. The team partners with operational, clinical and technical stakeholders to ensure technology decisions support strategic goals, reduce risk and create a cohesive digital ecosystem.






About The Role



As Application Architect, you will provide specialised architectural leadership for Microsoft application platforms across Monash Health. You will establish standards, provide architectural assurance and guide the safe, governed and effective use of Microsoft technologies including Power Platform and Microsoft 365. Working closely with Digital Applications teams, Cyber Security, IT Operations and business stakeholders, you will help ensure solutions are sustainable, supportable and aligned with enterprise architecture principles while enabling innovation across the organisation. 




What We're Looking For



You are an experienced Application Architect who thrives at the intersection of innovation, governance and business enablement. You bring deep expertise across Microsoft 365, Power Platform and modern application architecture, with the ability to balance creativity and agility with the controls required in a complex, highly regulated environment. You have extensive experience designing and governing solutions using Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages and Dataverse, and understand how these technologies can be applied to deliver meaningful business outcomes while maintaining security, compliance and sustainability.



You'll Also Bring:





Extensive experience designing and governing Microsoft 365 and Power Platform solutions.


Strong understanding of application architecture, platform governance and enterprise standards.


Experience working within highly regulated and complex environments.


Ability to provide practical architectural guidance to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


A passion for enabling innovation while maintaining strong governance and control frameworks. 






Experience in healthcare or digital health is highly regarded.




Why join Monash Health?



This is more than a digital role-it's your chance to transform healthcare at scale. Working at the intersection of clinical care, technology and innovation, you'll help create smarter digital solutions that improve patient outcomes and support the clinicians who deliver them every day




At Monash Health, you will:






Lead a state-wide service with real impact


Work within a values-driven, purpose-led organisation


Be part of a connected network of clinical, academic and system leaders


Help drive innovation, inclusion and better health outcomes








We also offer:






The opportunity to make a real impact on patient experience


A supportive, collaborative team environment


Ongoing learning and development opportunities


The chance to be part of Victoria's largest public health service






For a confidential discussion and to explore this opportunity further, please reach out to Robert Dashwood by email- Robert.Dashwoodo@monashhealth.org



To view the Position Description, click the link below




#8771 Application Architect Position Description.pdf





Our Culture and Values 



At Monash Health, our people are at the heart of everything we do. Our culture is inclusive, supportive and future-focused, underpinned by clear values and a commitment to continuous improvement. 



Our teams play a critical role in bringing our new strategy to life, challenging traditional approaches, embracing innovation, and ensuring every appointment reflects our commitment to equity, transparency and excellence. 



You'll be encouraged to share ideas, contribute to improvement initiatives, and grow alongside experienced professionals who are passionate about what they do. 




We are Full Hearted, Open Minded and All In, enabling excellent service delivery and a positive candidate and employee experience every time. 



We recognise the value of equal employment opportunity. We are committed to patient safety, promoting fairness, equity and diversity in the workplace and to Child Safe Standards. 




If you're passionate about helping clinicians embrace digital innovation and want to influence the future of healthcare at scale, we'd love to hear from you.




Applications are accepted via the Monash Health online EHub system. For information including how to apply and probity check requirements, please click here for the 'Application Guide'



Applications will be screened upon receipt and selection activity may commence prior to the closing date. 



Applications close: 5th August 2026    Click here to Apply now →
